content: The release of Bendy's Nightmare Run has a special nostalgic feeling for me having worked on it back in 2018. Happy to see it back and cannot wait for it's upcoming content. Have fun playing it and stay tooned! 💛🖤
Bendy's Nightmare Run is BACK! and more to come! 👀💛🖤

A departure from the norm but still feels like the Bendy world. The grittiness and unsettling environments mixed in with the brutalness and the various enemies is a very fun change to have fun with. Looking very good indeed! Alright, I'm going back to work now. 🖤💛
Very soon! 👀💛🖤
